== English Virtual Original comparison ==
October adds the +3 limit, removes the explicit once-per-turn phrase and narrows retrieval to controlled battlegrounds. The remaster names your deploy phase, replaces the per-musician bonus with +2 while controlling Clak’dor VII, drops the destiny and Never Tell Me The Odds clauses and requires battleground sites. The publisher’s separate archived composite and recovered Holotable image put the card pull last and omit the printed deploy-phase phrase. The period normal deployment timing remains the deploy phase. The complete printed slip supplies the comparison wording.
